name: android-tv-background
description: Docker for adelatour11's androidtvbackground. Create background wallpapers from Plex/Jellyfin/TMDB/Trakt. Useful to use with alternative android tv launchers such as Projectivy See full instructions: https://github.com/ninthwalker/androidtvbackground#docker-install-instructions

paths.name: Backgrounds Path
paths.description: Path where backgrounds will be saved

variables.name: PLEX Backgrounds
variables.description: Set to True to enable PLEX backgrounds

variables.name: JELLYFIN Backgrounds
variables.description: Set to True to enable JELLYFIN backgrounds

variables.name: TMDB Backgrounds
variables.description: Set to True to enable TMDB backgrounds

variables.name: TRAKT Backgrounds
variables.description: Set to True to enable TRAKT backgrounds

variables.name: CRON Schedule
variables.description: Set to a cron expression to create backgrounds automatically

variables.name: Post Python Script
variables.description: Set to True to run a custom python script

variables.name: Post Shell Script
variables.description: Set to True to run a custom shell script
